title: 期中阅读小篇
about_zh: 照北京初一期中的阅读题型写的 6 篇短文（细节、推断、主旨、猜词义），每篇 5 道题。只用小学词和 Starter 到 Unit 3 的词，生词加注；猜词义题考的那个词（guess: true）读完题再给中文。

passages.title: My Grandma
passages.label: 期中阅读 · 第 1 篇

tip.title: 先看题，再回原文找
lines: 先把 5 道题看一遍，知道要找什么。
每道题都回到原文，找到能证明答案的那一句再选。

sentences.en: My name is Lucy.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Lucy。
sentences.chunks: My name is Lucy.

trunk.subject: My name
trunk.note: 谁 = My name（我的名字），是什么 = is Lucy

sentences.en: I live with my grandma in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 我和奶奶住在北京。
sentences.chunks: I live / with my grandma / in Beijing.

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（我），干什么 = live（住）

sentences.en: My parents work abroad, so I only see them on the screen.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸妈妈在国外工作，所以我只能在屏幕上见到他们。
sentences.chunks: My parents work abroad, / so I only see them / on the screen.

trunk.subject: My parents
trunk.note: 谁 = My parents（我的父母），干什么 = work abroad（在国外工作）

sentences.en: Grandma is very strict.
sentences.zh: 奶奶很严格。
sentences.chunks: Grandma is very strict.

trunk.subject: Grandma
trunk.note: 谁 = Grandma（奶奶），怎么样 = is very strict（很严格）

sentences.en: She seldom smiles, and she checks my homework every evening.
sentences.zh: 她很少笑，每天晚上都检查我的作业。
sentences.chunks: She seldom smiles, / and she checks my homework / every evening.

trunk.subject: She
trunk.note: 谁 = She（奶奶），干什么 = seldom smiles（很少笑）；后半句 she checks（她检查）

sentences.en: When I make a mistake, she points it out and says, "Do it again."
sentences.zh: 我出错的时候，她会指出来，说：“再做一遍。”
sentences.chunks: When I make a mistake, / she points it out / and says, / "Do it again."

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（奶奶），干什么 = points it out（把它指出来）and says（说）

sentences.en: Sometimes I don't like her rules.
sentences.zh: 有时候我不喜欢她的规矩。
sentences.chunks: Sometimes / I don't like / her rules.

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（我），干什么 = don't like（不喜欢）

sentences.en: But Grandma cares about me in many ways.
sentences.zh: 可是奶奶在很多方面都关心我。
sentences.chunks: But Grandma cares about me / in many ways.

trunk.subject: Grandma
trunk.note: 谁 = Grandma，干什么 = cares about me（关心我）

sentences.en: Every morning, she gets up at six and makes breakfast for me.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，她六点起床，给我做早饭。
sentences.chunks: Every morning, / she gets up at six / and makes breakfast for me.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（奶奶），干什么 = gets up（起床）and makes breakfast（做早饭）

sentences.en: When it rains, she carries a big umbrella and waits for me at the school gate.
sentences.zh: 下雨的时候，她拿着一把大伞，在校门口等我。
sentences.chunks: When it rains, / she carries a big umbrella / and waits for me / at the school gate.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（奶奶），干什么 = carries（拿着）and waits for（等）

sentences.en: When I come home late, she is worried.
sentences.zh: 我回家晚了，她就很担心。
sentences.chunks: When I come home late, / she is worried.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（奶奶），怎么样 = is worried（担心）

sentences.en: She stands at the window and looks out at the road.
sentences.zh: 她站在窗边，望着外面的路。
sentences.chunks: She stands at the window / and looks out / at the road.

trunk.subject: She
trunk.note: 谁 = She（奶奶），干什么 = stands（站）and looks out（向外看）

sentences.en: When I am ill, she sits by my bed all night.
sentences.zh: 我生病的时候，她整夜坐在我床边。
sentences.chunks: When I am ill, / she sits by my bed / all night.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（奶奶），干什么 = sits（坐）

sentences.en: She also tells me stories about my father as a little boy.
sentences.zh: 她还给我讲我爸爸小时候的故事。
sentences.chunks: She also tells me stories / about my father / as a little boy.

trunk.subject: She
trunk.note: 谁 = She（奶奶），干什么 = tells me stories（给我讲故事）

sentences.en: Then I understand.
sentences.zh: 这时我明白了。
sentences.chunks: Then I understand.

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（我），干什么 = understand（明白）

sentences.en: Her rules come from her love.
sentences.zh: 她的规矩来自她的爱。
sentences.chunks: Her rules / come from her love.

trunk.subject: Her rules
trunk.note: 谁 = Her rules（她的规矩），干什么 = come from（来自）

sentences.en: Now I hug her every day.
sentences.zh: 现在我每天都抱抱她。
sentences.chunks: Now I hug her / every day.

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（我），干什么 = hug her（拥抱她）

sentences.en: She still seldom smiles, but I know she is happy.
sentences.zh: 她还是很少笑，但我知道她很开心。
sentences.chunks: She still seldom smiles, / but I know / she is happy.

trunk.subject: She
trunk.note: 谁 = She（奶奶），干什么 = still seldom smiles（还是很少笑）

questions.ask: Where do Lucy's parents work?
questions.zh: Lucy 的爸爸妈妈在哪儿工作？
hints: 回到第 3 句，那句讲的是爸爸妈妈。
关键词是 parents 和 work。第 3 句 work 后面紧跟的那个词就是答案。
排除“In Beijing”：第 2 句说住在北京的是 Lucy 和奶奶，不是爸爸妈妈。
答案是“Abroad”。第 3 句：My parents work abroad（我爸爸妈妈在国外工作），所以 Lucy 只能在屏幕上见到他们。

variant.ask: Where does Lucy live?
variant.zh: Lucy 住在哪儿？
variant.explain: 第 2 句：I live with my grandma in Beijing（我和奶奶住在北京）。在国外的是爸爸妈妈。

questions.ask: What does Grandma do when it rains?
questions.zh: 下雨的时候，奶奶做什么？
options: She waits for Lucy at the school gate.
She sits by Lucy's bed all night.
options_zh: 她整夜坐在 Lucy 床边。
questions.answer: She waits for Lucy at the school gate.
hints: 找有 rains 的那一句。
关键词是 when it rains（下雨的时候），在第 10 句开头。看它后面奶奶做了什么。
排除“She makes breakfast for Lucy”：第 9 句说的是每天早上做早饭，和下雨没关系。
答案是“She waits for Lucy at the school gate”。第 10 句：下雨的时候，她拿着一把大伞，在 school gate 等我。

variant.ask: What does Grandma do when Lucy is ill?
variant.zh: Lucy 生病的时候，奶奶做什么？
options: She sits by Lucy's bed all night.
options_zh: 她整夜坐在 Lucy 床边。
她检查 Lucy 的作业。
variant.answer: She sits by Lucy's bed all night.
variant.explain: 第 13 句：When I am ill, she sits by my bed all night（我生病的时候，她整夜坐在我床边）。关键词是 ill。

questions.ask: What is the meaning of "gate" in Sentence 10?
questions.zh: 第 10 句里的 gate 是什么意思？
hints: 回到第 10 句，看 gate 前后的词。
gate 前面是 school。奶奶 waits for me at the school gate：她在学校的某个地方等 Lucy 放学出来。
排除“书包”：人不能站在书包那儿等人。
答案是“大门”。奶奶拿着伞在学校的 gate 等 Lucy，接孩子都在校门口，所以 school gate 是“校门”，gate 就是“大门”。

variant.ask: What is the meaning of "screen" in Sentence 3?
variant.zh: 第 3 句里的 screen 是什么意思？
variant.explain: 爸爸妈妈在国外，Lucy 只能 on the screen 见到他们：在手机或电脑的屏幕上视频。screen 就是“屏幕”。

questions.ask: What is Grandma like?
questions.zh: 奶奶是个什么样的人？
hints: 把第 4 句和第 8 句连起来看。
第 4 句说 Grandma is very strict（很严格）；第 8 句说 Grandma cares about me in many ways（在很多方面关心我）。
排除“Happy and silly”：第 5 句和第 18 句都说她 seldom smiles（很少笑），她一点也不傻乎乎。
答案是“Strict but kind”。她很严格（第 4 句），可是早上做早饭、下雨去接、生病整夜陪着（第 9 到 13 句），都说明她心好。原文没有直接写 kind，要把几句连起来想。

variant.ask: How does Lucy feel about Grandma now?
variant.zh: 现在 Lucy 对奶奶是什么感情？
variant.explain: 第 17 句：Now I hug her every day（现在我每天都抱抱她）。每天拥抱，说明她爱奶奶。

questions.ask: What is the story about?
questions.zh: 这篇短文主要讲什么？
options_zh: Lucy 严格又心好的奶奶。
Lucy 的爸爸妈妈和他们的工作。
hints: 主旨题看全文：从头到尾，一直在讲谁？
第 4 句（奶奶很严格）、第 8 句（奶奶关心我）、第 16 句（她的规矩来自爱），讲的都是 Grandma。
排除“Lucy's big umbrella”：伞只在第 10 句出现了一次，是一个小细节。
答案是“Lucy's strict but kind grandma”。全文都在讲奶奶：她很严格，可是处处关心 Lucy，她的规矩里是爱。

variant.ask: What does Lucy want to tell us?
variant.zh: Lucy 最想告诉我们什么？
options: Grandma's rules come from her love.
options_zh: 奶奶的规矩来自她的爱。
Lucy 的爸爸妈妈在国外工作。
variant.answer: Grandma's rules come from her love.
variant.explain: 第 15、16 句：Then I understand. Her rules come from her love（这时我明白了：她的规矩来自她的爱）。这是 Lucy 读懂奶奶以后最想说的话；爸爸妈妈在国外、出错、雨伞都是小细节。

passages.label: 期中阅读 · 第 2 篇

tip.title: 不认识的词，看前后句猜
lines: 遇到不认识的词先别停，往下读。
看看它长得像哪个认识的词，再看前后句在说什么。

sentences.en: Today is Tom's first day at junior high.
sentences.zh: 今天是 Tom 上初中的第一天。
sentences.chunks: Today is / Tom's first day / at junior high.

trunk.subject: Today
trunk.note: 谁 = Today（今天），是什么 = is Tom's first day（Tom 的第一天）

sentences.en: He is very nervous.
sentences.zh: 他很紧张。
sentences.chunks: He is very nervous.

trunk.subject: He
trunk.note: 谁 = He（Tom），怎么样 = is very nervous（很紧张）

sentences.en: He doesn't know any students in his new school.
sentences.zh: 新学校里的同学，他一个也不认识。
sentences.chunks: He doesn't know / any students / in his new school.

trunk.subject: He
trunk.note: 谁 = He（Tom），干什么 = doesn't know（不认识）

keys.zh: 任何一个（不认识 any = 一个也不认识）

sentences.en: The school is big, and Tom can't find his classroom.
sentences.zh: 学校很大，Tom 找不到自己的教室。
sentences.chunks: The school is big, / and Tom can't find / his classroom.

trunk.subject: The school
trunk.note: 谁 = The school，怎么样 = is big（很大）；后半句 Tom can't find（Tom 找不到）

sentences.en: A girl in a red jacket comes over.
sentences.zh: 一个穿红夹克的女孩走了过来。
sentences.chunks: A girl in a red jacket / comes over.

trunk.subject: A girl in a red jacket
trunk.note: 谁 = A girl in a red jacket（穿红夹克的女孩），干什么 = comes over（走过来）

sentences.en: "Hi, I'm Kate," she says.
sentences.zh: “你好，我是 Kate，”她说。
sentences.chunks: "Hi, I'm Kate," / she says.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（那个女孩），干什么 = says（说）

sentences.en: "I am a volunteer here, and I can help you."
sentences.zh: “我是这里的志愿者，我可以帮你。”
sentences.chunks: "I am a volunteer here, / and I can help you."

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（Kate），是什么 = am a volunteer（是志愿者）；后半句 I can help you（我能帮你）

sentences.en: Kate takes Tom to the teaching building.
sentences.zh: Kate 带 Tom 去教学楼。
sentences.chunks: Kate takes Tom / to the teaching building.

trunk.subject: Kate
trunk.note: 谁 = Kate，干什么 = takes Tom（带 Tom 去）

sentences.en: His classroom is on the third floor, next to the lab.
sentences.zh: 他的教室在三楼，就在实验室旁边。
sentences.chunks: His classroom is / on the third floor, / next to the lab.

trunk.subject: His classroom
trunk.note: 谁 = His classroom（他的教室），在哪 = is on the third floor（在三楼）

sentences.en: On the way, Kate tells him about the school.
sentences.zh: 路上，Kate 给他讲学校的情况。
sentences.chunks: On the way, / Kate tells him / about the school.

trunk.subject: Kate
trunk.note: 谁 = Kate，干什么 = tells him（告诉他）

sentences.en: "The dining hall is behind the library, and the food there is delicious," she says.
sentences.zh: “食堂在图书馆后面，那儿的饭菜很好吃，”她说。
sentences.chunks: "The dining hall is behind the library, / and the food there is delicious," / she says.

trunk.subject: she
trunk.note: 谁 = she（Kate），干什么 = says（说）；她说的话里：The dining hall is behind the library（食堂在图书馆后面）

sentences.en: In the classroom, Tom sits next to a boy called Jack.
sentences.zh: 在教室里，Tom 坐在一个叫 Jack 的男孩旁边。
sentences.chunks: In the classroom, / Tom sits / next to a boy called Jack.

trunk.subject: Tom
trunk.note: 谁 = Tom，干什么 = sits（坐）next to a boy（在一个男孩旁边）

sentences.en: Jack is friendly, and he likes basketball too.
sentences.zh: Jack 很友好，他也喜欢篮球。
sentences.chunks: Jack is friendly, / and he likes basketball too.

trunk.subject: Jack
trunk.note: 谁 = Jack，怎么样 = is friendly；后半句 he likes basketball（他喜欢篮球）

sentences.en: At lunch, they eat together in the dining hall.
sentences.zh: 午饭时，他们一起在食堂吃饭。
sentences.chunks: At lunch, / they eat together / in the dining hall.

trunk.subject: they
trunk.note: 谁 = they（Tom 和 Jack），干什么 = eat together（一起吃饭）

sentences.en: After lunch, Kate shows them the club wall.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，Kate 带他们去看社团墙。
sentences.chunks: After lunch, / Kate shows them / the club wall.

trunk.subject: Kate
trunk.note: 谁 = Kate，干什么 = shows them（给他们看）

sentences.en: There are many clubs, like the music club, the art club and the basketball club.
sentences.zh: 有很多社团，比如音乐社、美术社和篮球社。
sentences.chunks: There are many clubs, / like the music club, / the art club / and the basketball club.

trunk.subject: many clubs
trunk.note: 有什么 = There are many clubs（有很多社团）

sentences.en: Tom and Jack join the basketball club.
sentences.zh: Tom 和 Jack 参加了篮球社。
sentences.chunks: Tom and Jack join / the basketball club.

trunk.subject: Tom and Jack
trunk.note: 谁 = Tom and Jack，干什么 = join（参加）

sentences.en: In the evening, Tom writes in his diary.
sentences.zh: 晚上，Tom 在日记里写道：
sentences.chunks: In the evening, / Tom writes / in his diary.

trunk.subject: Tom
trunk.note: 谁 = Tom，干什么 = writes（写）

sentences.en: "My new school is great."
sentences.zh: “我的新学校很棒。”
sentences.chunks: "My new school is great."

trunk.subject: My new school
trunk.note: 谁 = My new school（我的新学校），怎么样 = is great（很棒）

sentences.en: "I am not nervous now, and I have two new friends!"
sentences.zh: “我现在不紧张了，我有了两个新朋友！”
sentences.chunks: "I am not nervous now, / and I have / two new friends!"

trunk.subject: I
trunk.note: 谁 = I（Tom），怎么样 = am not nervous（不紧张了）；后半句 I have（我有）

questions.ask: Why is Tom nervous at first?
questions.zh: Tom 一开始为什么紧张？
hints: 回到开头，看第 2 句和它后面那一句。
关键词是 nervous，在第 2 句。紧张的原因写在紧跟着的第 3 句。
排除“He can't play basketball”：第 13 句说 Jack 也（too）喜欢篮球，说明 Tom 喜欢篮球，原文没说他不会打。
答案是“He doesn't know any students”。第 3 句：He doesn't know any students in his new school（新学校里的同学他一个也不认识），所以他紧张。

variant.ask: Why can't Tom find his classroom?
variant.zh: Tom 为什么找不到教室？
variant.explain: 第 4 句：The school is big, and Tom can't find his classroom（学校很大，Tom 找不到教室）。

questions.ask: Where is Tom's classroom?
questions.zh: Tom 的教室在哪儿？
hints: 找有 classroom 的句子。第 4 句没说在哪，再往后找。
关键词是 His classroom，在第 9 句开头。
排除“Behind the library”：第 11 句说在图书馆后面的是 dining hall（食堂），不是教室。
答案是“Next to the lab”。第 9 句：His classroom is on the third floor, next to the lab（他的教室在三楼，就在实验室旁边）。是三楼，不是一楼。

variant.ask: Where is the dining hall?
variant.zh: 食堂在哪儿？
variant.explain: 第 11 句 Kate 说：The dining hall is behind the library（食堂在图书馆后面）。实验室旁边、三楼说的是 Tom 的教室。

questions.ask: What is the meaning of "friendly" in Sentence 13?
questions.zh: 第 13 句里的 friendly 是什么意思？
hints: 看第 13 句和后面的第 14 句。
friendly 长得像 friend（朋友）。第 14 句说，午饭时他们一起吃饭。
排除“生气的”：Jack 要是生气，Tom 不会和他一起吃饭、一起参加篮球社。
答案是“友好的”。friend 是朋友，friendly 就是“像朋友一样的，友好的”。Jack 对 Tom 很友好，所以他们一起吃饭，晚上 Tom 写他有了两个新朋友。

variant.ask: What is the meaning of "volunteer" in Sentence 7?
variant.zh: 第 7 句里的 volunteer 是什么意思？
variant.explain: 第 5 句说 Kate 是一个女孩（a girl），不是老师；第 7 句她说自己是 volunteer，还说 I can help you（我能帮你）。在学校帮新同学的女孩，是志愿者。

questions.ask: How does Tom feel in the evening?
questions.zh: 晚上 Tom 感觉怎么样？
hints: 看最后两句：Tom 晚上在日记里写了什么。
关键词 In the evening 在第 18 句，日记里写的是第 19、20 句。
排除“Nervous”：第 20 句说 I am not nervous now（我现在不紧张了）。
答案是“Happy”。他写 My new school is great（新学校很棒），还有了两个新朋友，所以他很开心。原文没写 happy，要从这两句推出来。

variant.ask: How does Tom feel in the morning?
variant.zh: 早上 Tom 感觉怎么样？
variant.explain: 第 2 句：He is very nervous（他很紧张）。这是上学第一天的早上，他一个同学也不认识。

questions.ask: Which is the best name for the story?
questions.zh: 哪个最适合做这篇短文的标题？
options: Tom's First Day at Junior High
questions.answer: Tom's First Day at Junior High
hints: 标题要管住全文：看第 1 句和最后一句（第 20 句）。
第 1 句：Today is Tom's first day at junior high。全文从早上讲到晚上，讲的都是这一天。
排除“A Delicious Lunch”：午饭只在第 11、14 句提到，是一个小细节。
答案是“Tom's First Day at Junior High”。全文讲 Tom 上初中的第一天：从紧张、找不到教室，到交了新朋友，晚上很开心。

variant.ask: How does Tom feel from morning to evening?
variant.zh: 从早上到晚上，Tom 的心情是怎样的？
variant.explain: 第 2 句早上 He is very nervous（他很紧张）；第 20 句晚上 I am not nervous now, and I have two new friends（不紧张了，有了新朋友）。全文就是这一天从紧张到开心的经过。

passages.label: 期中阅读 · 第 3 篇

tip.title: 标题题：看开头和结尾
lines: 问“最好的标题”，要管住整篇，不能只管一句。
看开头怎么开始，结尾怎么结束，中间只出现一次的细节不选。

sentences.en: Amy is in the photography club at her school.
sentences.zh: Amy 是学校摄影社的。
sentences.chunks: Amy is / in the photography club / at her school.

trunk.subject: Amy

排除“They get the first prize”：得一等奖的是第 17 句给 Snowy 拍的那张，不是公园里的照片。
答案是“They all look the same”。第 7 句她一张也不喜欢，第 8 句她说：They all look the same（它们看起来都一样）。

questions.ask: What can we learn from the story?

options: Good photos can be all around us.

我们一定要在公园里拍照。
questions.answer: Good photos can be all around us.
questions.drop: We must take photos in the park.
hints: 看最后几句：老师在照片下面写了什么。
关键词是 Nature is all around us（第 20 句）。再想想，Amy 得奖的照片是在哪儿拍的？
排除“We must take photos in the park”：得奖的那张不是在公园拍的，是在家里窗边拍的（第 13、17 句）。
答案是“Good photos can be all around us”。Amy 在公园拍了很多张都不满意，在家给 Snowy 拍的却得了一等奖。老师写：大自然就在我们身边，好照片也可能就在身边。

questions.ask: Which is the best name for the story?
questions.zh: 哪个最适合做这个故事的标题？
hints: 标题要管住整个故事。故事最后的结果是什么？
第 17 句 Amy 给 Snowy 拍了照片，第 19 句这张照片得了一等奖。全文都在讲为了比赛找一张好照片。
排除“Birds and Flowers”：鸟和花只在第 6 句出现，而且 Amy 不喜欢那些照片。
答案是“A Photo of Snowy”。故事讲 Amy 为了比赛找好照片：公园里拍的都不满意，最后在家给 Snowy 拍的那张得了一等奖。“A Saturday in the Rain”只讲了中间一段。

variant.ask: What is the story about?

options: Amy finds a good photo at home.
options_zh: Amy 在家里找到了一张好照片。
variant.answer: Amy finds a good photo at home.
variant.explain: 故事从比赛开始：公园里拍的她都不喜欢；下雨在家，她给窗边的 Snowy 拍了一张（第 13、17 句），这张得了一等奖（第 19 句）。讲的就是她在家里找到了好照片。

第 2 句 Here are three new students and their clubs，后面三段，一段讲一个同学。
排除“An animal home near the school”：动物之家只在第 4 段讲 David 时说到，管不住整篇。
答案是“Three students and their clubs”。第 2 句已经说了：三个新同学和他们的社团，后面三段一人一段。

variant.ask: How many new students does the passage talk about?
variant.zh: 这篇短文讲了几个新同学？
variant.explain: 第 2 句：Here are three new students and their clubs（下面是三个新同学和他们的社团）。后面三段一段讲一个：李明、王芳、David。
